items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar formally warned for fan incident in F1 Mexico GP paddock
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar has received a formal warning from the Mexico Grand Prix stewards for shoving a fan who was trying to take a selfie in the Formula 1 paddock before opening practice.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因墨西哥大奖赛围场推搡车迷事件受到正式警告
这位红牛车手推开了一名试图自拍的车迷
伊萨克·哈贾尔因在首次练习前于一级方程式围场推搡一名车迷，被墨西哥大奖赛赛会干事给予正式警告。
这位红牛车手最初因周五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道涉嫌“不当行为”的事件被传唤。
哈贾尔曾被一名试图拍照的车迷接近，但他两次被推开，因此这位法国车手违反了《国际体育法典》第12.2.1.l条。
一份报告写道：“干事听取了6号车（伊萨克·哈贾尔）的车手和车队代表的陈述，并查看了视频证据。
“该车手表示，他当时正赶着去参加第一节练习赛，停下来与一名年轻车迷合影，这时一名围场访客以咄咄逼人的方式接近了他。
“一名安保人员走在他身后，无法介入并阻止这种无异于侵犯车手私人空间的行为。
“该车手起初抵抗这一举动，将手放在该嘉宾的腰部，将其挡开，随后车手用张开的右手将他推到一边。
“车手的后一行为被视为违反规定，但在减轻处罚时，干事考虑了以下事项：
“a) 车手是在对另一人未经邀请且相当具有攻击性的行为作出反应
“b) 车手当时正努力穿过拥挤区域前往第一节自由练习（FP1）的起点
“c) 该车手当时没有足够的安保人员在场
“d) 该访客未经他同意侵入了他的个人空间
“e) 车手们在穿行围场时普遍遇到的问题。”
随后，哈贾尔经历了一个相当令人沮丧的周五，他在首节一小时练习赛中仅排名第11位，落后最快圈速创造者夏尔·勒克莱尔1.417秒。
这位22岁的车手受到动力单元问题困扰，仅完成了21圈，这是第三低的圈数，仅高于阿斯顿·马丁车队的杰克·克劳福德和奥迪车队的弗雷迪·斯莱特。
不过他在第二节练习赛中的情况略有改善，哈贾尔获得第六名，落后再次位居榜首的勒克莱尔0.410秒，而队友马克斯·维斯塔潘位列第五。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar formally warned for fan incident in F1 Mexico GP paddock
The Red Bull driver shoved away a fan who was attempting to take a selfie
Isack Hadjar has been given a formal warning by the Mexico Grand Prix stewards for shoving a fan in the Formula 1 paddock ahead of opening practice.
The Red Bull driver was initially summoned for an alleged incident of “misconduct” at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday.
Hadjar had been approached by a fan attempting to take a picture, but he was shoved away twice and the Frenchman consequently breached Article 12.2.1.l of the International Sporting Code.
A report read: “The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar) and the team representative and reviewed video evidence.
“The driver stated that he was running late for FP1 and had stopped to have a photograph with a young fan, when he was approached by a paddock guest in an aggressive manner.
“One security person was walking behind him and was unable to intervene and prevent what was tantamount to an invasion of the driver’s private space.
“The driver initially resisted the move by placing his hand on the waist of the guest, holding him at bay, then the driver pushed him aside with his open right hand.
“This latter action by the driver is regarded as a breach of the regulations however in mitigation of penalty the stewards considered the following matters:
“a) The driver was reacting to an uninvited and rather aggressive action by another person
“b) The driver was endeavouring to make his way to the start of FP1 through a congested area
“c) The driver did not have sufficient security present
“d) The guest was invading his personal space without his consent
“e) The general issue drivers have experienced moving through the paddock.”
What followed was a rather frustrating Friday for Hadjar, who finished a lowly 11th in the opening one-hour practice session, 1.417s off pacesetter Charles Leclerc.
The 22-year-old was plagued by power unit problems, causing him to complete just 21 laps and that was the third-lowest total ahead of Jak Crawford (Aston Martin) and Freddie Slater (Audi).
His situation did slightly improve in FP2 though, as Hadjar finished sixth and 0.410s behind Leclerc, who was again on top, with team-mate Max Verstappen claiming fifth.
keyPointsZh: 哈贾尔最初因周五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道涉嫌“不当行为”被传唤。
keyPointsEn: Hadjar was initially summoned over an alleged incident of "misconduct" at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday.

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔因推搡围场访客获正式警告
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔因在墨西哥大奖赛第一次练习赛前推搡一名围场访客，被F1赛会干事给予正式警告。
items.originalTitle: Hadjar escapes with warning for pushing Mexico F1 paddock guest
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar has been given a formal warning for pushing a paddock guest ahead of the first Formula 1 practice session at the Mexican Grand Prix.
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因在墨西哥大奖赛第一次练习赛前推搡一名围场访客，被给予正式警告。
社交媒体周五流传的视频显示，哈贾尔推搡了一名试图与他自拍的人。
这名红牛车手随后于周六上午被叫去见F1赛会干事，传唤文件将此事描述为“涉嫌不当行为”。
哈贾尔在赛会干事面前表示，他当时正赶着去参加第一次练习赛，在停下来与一名年轻车迷合影后，被一名围场访客以带有攻击性的方式接近。
干事文件详细记录了该事件的经过，并写道“一名安保人员当时走在哈贾尔身后，未能
介入并阻止这一等同于侵犯车手私人空间的行为”。
哈贾尔起初对这一举动进行了抵抗，随后“用张开的右手将他推到一边”——这违反了国际汽联国际体育法典第12.2.1.l条关于不当行为的规定。
然而，在仅给予警告的处罚时，干事依据国际体育法典附录B中的指导原则，认可了五项对哈贾尔有利的减轻情节。
这些情况是：哈贾尔当时“在回应另一人未经邀请且相当激进的举动”；他正试图穿过拥挤区域前往红牛车库参加第一节练习；现场没有“足够”的安保人员；那名嘉宾未经同意侵入了他的个人空间；以及车手们在围场内通行时面临的“普遍问题”。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar has been given a formal warning for pushing a guest in the paddock ahead of the first Formula 1 practice session at the Mexican Grand Prix.
Footage circulated on social media on Friday that appeared to show Hadjar pushing someone who had tried to take a selfie with him.
The Red Bull driver was subsequently called to see the F1 stewards on Saturday morning for what the summons document described as 'alleged misconduct'.

Hadjar stated in his appearance in front of the stewards that he was running late for FP1 and, having stopped for a photograph with a young fan, was "approached by a paddock guest in an aggressive manner".
The stewards' document detailing that account also said "one security person was walking behind him [Hadjar] and was unable to
intervene and prevent what was tantamount to an invasion of the driver's private space".
Having initially resisted that move, Hadjar subsequently "pushed him aside with his open right hand" - a breach of article 12.2.1.l of the FIA international sporting code relating to misconduct.
However, in awarding only a warning the stewards acknowledge five mitigating circumstances in Hadjar's favour, in line with the guidelines in appendix B of the ISC.

These were that Hadjar was "reacting to an uninvited and rather aggressive action by another person"; that he was trying to make his way to the Red Bull garage for FP1 through a congested area; that he did not have "sufficient" security present; that the guest invaded his personal space without consent; and the "general issue" drivers have moving through the paddock.
keyPointsZh: 社交媒体周五流传的视频显示，哈贾尔推搡了一名试图与他自拍的人。
哈贾尔向赛会干事表示，他当时正赶着去参加第一次练习赛，在停下来与一名年轻车迷合影后，被一名围场访客以带有攻击性的方式接近。
keyPointsEn: Footage circulated on social media on Friday appeared to show Hadjar pushing someone who had tried to take a selfie with him.
Hadjar told the stewards he was running late for FP1 and, after stopping for a photograph with a young fan, was "approached by a paddock guest in an aggressive manner".

items.originalTitle: Mercedes out of performance window at Mexico GP - George Russell
items.summaryEn: George Russell said the upgraded Mercedes was outside the optimum set-up window in Friday practice at the Mexico Grand Prix, as he again struggled to find the right set-up.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯在墨西哥大奖赛未处最佳性能区间——乔治·拉塞尔
拉塞尔再次面临难以让升级后的梅赛德斯F1赛车进入最佳调校区间的困难
乔治·拉塞尔在升级后的梅赛德斯F1赛车上遭遇更多困难，因为该车在墨西哥大奖赛周五练习中未能处于最佳调校区间。
这支领跑积分榜的车队本月为马来西亚站引入了升级版W17，但该车被红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘轻松击败，随后在新加坡站也出现了类似情况。
安东内利在奥斯汀从杆位起步获胜，终结了维斯塔潘的连胜，但他的梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔近三站却接连遭遇退赛、第九名和第八名。
拉塞尔将此归因于升级套件的工作窗口很窄，他认为这一点在墨西哥再次显现，尽管他在第二节练习中排名第三，仅落后法拉利标杆勒克莱尔十分之一秒。
“我觉得我们仍未完全吃透新套件，”拉塞尔说道，他的赛车在首节练习中由弗雷德里克·维斯蒂驾驶。
“我们看到存在一些平衡性限制，我们正努力克服却难以解决。”
“我想说目前对基米和我来说，我们可能更多在窗口之外，类似于我们在马来西亚看到的情况，而不是像基米在奥斯汀那样处于窗口之内。”
“但希望过夜之后我们能把它调回那个状态。”
勒克莱尔在周五的两节练习中都排名第一，这对拉塞尔来说并不意外，他将法拉利列为周末前的热门，因为其在高海拔条件下没有涡轮迟滞。
这对在墨西哥取得成功至关重要，因为在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道这样的赛道上涡轮工作更吃力，而众所周知SF-26的涡轮比对手更小。
不过，这并不是阻碍梅赛德斯的唯一方面，因为当被追问赛车需要在哪些方面改进时，拉塞尔回答说：“平衡。”
“过弯平衡没有达到我们想要的状态，赛车整体也不像我们希望的那样协调，所以是的，这需要一些工作。”
但对梅赛德斯来说，现在还不是恐慌的时候，尤其是勒克莱尔在美国大奖赛周五的两节练习中都名列前茅——结果随后安东内利却占据了统治地位。
“对我们来说，今天是扎实的一天——我会说不是特别惊艳，但很扎实，”副车队领队布拉德利·洛德说道。
“这里在动力单元冷却、刹车冷却以及这些涡轮的增压管理方面都有很多挑战，因为我们现在没有像过去几年那样有MGU-H来帮忙。”
“所以这是一个很难把所有事情都做对的地方，要在单圈中跑得快，同时还要能在长距离中保持节奏。”
“我们已经回答了一些问题。我们还需要进一步挖掘数据，找出明天和周日的最佳折中方案。”
detailEn: Mercedes out of performance window at Mexico GP - George Russell
Russell is again facing difficulties nailing the set-up window of the newly updated Mercedes F1 car
George Russell is enduring further difficulties with the upgraded Mercedes Formula 1 car, as it was outside the optimum set-up in Friday practice at the Mexico Grand Prix.
The championship-leading squad introduced an updated W17 for Malaysia this month, but it was easily beaten by Red Bull’s Max Verstappen before a similar story in Singapore.
Kimi Antonelli ended Verstappen’s run by winning from pole in Austin, but his Mercedes team-mate Russell has been struggling with a DNF, P9 and P8 across the last three rounds.

Russell put this down to the upgrades having a narrow operating window, which he thinks was seen again in Mexico despite finishing third in FP2 and only a tenth behind Ferrari pacesetter Charles Lelcerc.
“I think still not fully on top of the new package,” claimed Russell, whose car was driven by Frederik Vesti in opening practice.
“We see there's some balance limitations we have that we're struggling to overcome.
"I would say currently for Kimi and I, we're probably more outside the window, similar to what we saw in Malaysia, than inside the window like Kimi achieved in Austin.
“But hopefully overnight we can get it back there.”
Leclerc topped both Friday sessions, which came as little surprise to Russell, who labelled Ferrari as the pre-weekend favourite due to its lack of turbo lag in the high altitude conditions.
This is crucial for success in Mexico as the turbo works harder at circuits like Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez and the SF-26 is known to have a smaller one than its rivals.
That is not the only aspect holding Mercedes back though, as when pressed on where the car needs to improve, Russell replied: “The balance.
“The through-corner balance isn’t where we want it and the car isn’t quite as together as we’d like it, so yeah it’s going to require a bit of work.”
But it is not panic stations for Mercedes just yet, particularly as Leclerc also topped both Friday practice sessions at the United States Grand Prix – only for Antonelli to subsequently dominate.
“Solid day for us, I'd say – not spectacular, but solid,” said deputy team principal Bradley Lord.

“There's a lot of challenges here with PU cooling, with brake cooling, with boost management with these turbos, now that we don't have an MGU-H to help us out with that as we have done for the last few years.
“So this is a tricky place to get everything right, to be quick on a single lap, but then also be able to maintain your pace for the long run.
“So we've answered a few of those questions. We've got a bit more digging to do through the data to find exactly the best compromise for tomorrow and Sunday.”
